sentences.text: The defining fossil material includes three broken pieces of the lower jaw.
This jaw held between twelve and seventeen teeth.
Pores at the jaw's front indicate a soft tissue or keratin covering once existed there.
The creature possessed a wingspan measuring roughly 135 centimeters.
Scientists propose it was a land-based forager because of its long limbs.
Its slender wings suggest it likely flew by soaring.
It may have hunted fish and potentially pursued prey underwater.
A 2020 study by Matthew G. Baron placed Caviramus in the family Caviramidae.
It inhabited the Northern Calcareous Alps of Switzerland during the Late Triassic.
This period spans from 211.18 to 201.4 million years ago.
Researchers debate whether Raeticodactylus filisurensis is a synonym of Caviramus, with differences possibly due to sex or age.
